''See also: [[Ruler Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A Ruler is a type of practitioner who utilizes their [[madra]] as a catalyst to manipulate and control [[vital aura]]. Unlike other methods, [[Ruler techniques]] involve the ability to command environmental elements, such as [[wind]], or influence space. These techniques require significant concentration and time to execute compared to more immediate striking methods. Those following the [[Path of the White Fox]] can specifically use light and dream-based [[aura]] to ensnare opponents in illusions. The power associated with a Ruler is significant enough to force others into submission, inflict intense physical agony, or even cause death. Some individuals may possess knowledge of multiple disciplines, such as combining Ruler and [[Forger techniques]]. In a political context, the term also refers to heads of state, such as kings, emperors, or empresses. Historical figures like King [[Daruman the First]] are noted for their wisdom and ability to usher in golden ages through stable leadership. Some rulers possess authority that is both political and conceptual, which can sometimes be preserved through specialized items like condensed gems.}}
